source: Caller-pinned enriched native cohort, reconciliation database and all six immutable source archives. Never substitute the merged photo table.
grain: One job per unique photo; retain every native observation-photo link, every external observation sharing a target photo, and every archived target-photo version/locator.
selection: No taxon cap, observation cap, spatial thinning or phenotype filtering. Scheduling partitions use the full-source dependence component hash, never split a known component, and are not validation folds.
license_rule: All archived target-photo versions, including versions linked to a non-native/unselected observation, must agree on one code in the inherited operational allowlist. Missing/unknown/conflicting codes remain explicit blocked states. This is a recorded-code screen, not independent legal clearance or a license to republish images.
url_rule: Keep raw URLs. Canonicalize recognized size suffixes to original only; require http/https and a known iNaturalist image host, no credentials/ports/query/fragment and a matching photo ID in /photos/ID/. Every available source URL and version must agree on the same original URL; do not invent URLs for missing/invalid versions.
source_preference: No last-record or most-complete-record preference for photo rights/identity. Compare all archived metadata and API photo versions; source record hashes and reconciliation locators must agree.
worker_boundary: The schedule database contains opaque observation/component/photo IDs, source locators, photo URL/license/attribution fields and states, not location, dates, source user IDs, taxon labels, environmental values or traits. Raw source archives and enriched observations remain separate pinned inputs.
retention: Keep blocked jobs/links. Unscheduled is not no detection, missing traits or biological absence. Existing source files are read-only.
